modeling_decisions: Viewed original concept: woody upper branching crown and individual broad hanging leaves clear. Reject overprominent central leaf keel and overly tapered willow shapes; use parallel sides over central leaf length, equal subtle longitudinal vein bands, no dominant midrib. Preserve bare lower trunk and non-mangrove base.
